claim_en: THE MAIDSERVANT ON HER HAPAX TOKENS. 'Designated', 'not redeemed', 'inquest' once each in the Tanakh, 'freed' twice in the verse, the redemption verb at Exod 21:8 and here alone; the inquest = her lashes, the death withheld, the freed woman's mode by call; the ram by three live calls (the Lev 5 floor and pointer, the Tzav law); 'which he sinned' twice = the deliberate as the erring; Keritot 2:4 = Chapter 5 8-10. Filed F-223, auto-seated (sitting L4b).
middah: ink (the maidservant's hapax tokens — 'designated', 'not redeemed', 'inquest' once each, 'freed' twice; 'which he sinned' twice as the deliberate-as-erring, E10, beside; Keritot 2:4 as the Sifra's rows)
